evidence.detail: Detached checkout HEAD exactly matches the launcher-bound target SHA; the working tree was clean.
The supplied base exists and the exact base-to-target diff contains six documentation/workflow files and no product source changes.
The supplied base is not an ancestor of the target. Review scope therefore used the launcher's explicit two-tree diff rather than a linear commit range.
The repaired walkthrough correctly directs alternate-port users to the port selected in the preceding step, and the persistence statement is limited to CAreview tenant data and credentials.
Independent unittest execution ran 80 tests but exited 1 because all 19 socket-based server tests were denied loopback binding by the review sandbox; the remaining 61 tests passed.
Independent compilation exited 1 because the read-only checkout denied creation of __pycache__.
Independent governance validation exited 1 because no writable temporary directory was available.

The committed handoff reports successful out-of-band compile, 80-test, governance, and clean-checkout runs, but these are author-recorded claims rather than independently reproducible command output in this review.
The exact diff passed git diff --check.

evidence: Expected: acceptance criteria 1 and 2 require independently verifiable clean-checkout, compile, and unittest evidence against cc98f4e616af13b182fc96966c8445daa5bcdc75.

Observed: unittest exited 1 after 80 tests with 19 PermissionError failures caused by prohibited socket binding; py_compile exited 1 because __pycache__ could not be written; governance validation exited 1 because no writable temporary directory exists.
The handoff records successful author runs, but the review prompt and AGENTS.md require author claims to be treated as claims unless supported by independently available command evidence.
findings.remediation: Preserve the author’s exact-SHA check record and provide independently inspectable raw command or CI evidence bound to cc98f4e616af13b182fc96966c8445daa5bcdc75, or apply the already recorded DECISION-004 human gate policy outside this review. No source repair is implied by the sandbox failures.
findings.title: Required execution evidence cannot be independently verified
findings.verification: Run the four ISSUE-0006 checks in an environment permitting loopback sockets, bytecode output, and temporary directories; record exact SHA, commands, exit codes, and relevant raw output.

evidence: Expected: CURRENT.md must name the current gate and next permitted action from repository state alone.
Observed: lines 29-31 say the repair-1 candidate exists and is pending re-review, while lines 35-36 still instruct Claude to repair and commit that candidate before invoking review.
This repeats the stale-state defect that the repair claims to resolve and can send a fresh task backward into already completed work.
findings.remediation: Update the next actor/action to the fresh Codex re-review of the already committed repair-1 candidate. Bind the candidate to its exact SHA where the workflow permits, and describe the subsequent DECISION-004/005 handling conditionally on the new report.
findings.title: Current-state index still points to the completed repair step
findings.verification: Read CURRENT.md from a fresh context and confirm its candidate, latest-review, next-actor, and next-action fields consistently identify re-review of cc98f4e616af13b182fc96966c8445daa5bcdc75 as the immediate step.

evidence: Expected: user-facing status should distinguish implemented functionality from workflow and milestone completion.

Observed: README declares “MVP complete,” while project/status/CURRENT.md records ISSUE-0006 as REPAIRING, its review pending, and M1 still in progress; ROADMAP.md requires all six issues and four milestone reviews before M1 completion.
The wording therefore claims completion before the repository's own definition of done has been met.
findings.remediation: Describe the feature set as implemented while explicitly stating that ISSUE-0006 and the M1 review/acceptance gates remain pending, or defer the “MVP complete” label until those gates are recorded.
findings.title: README prematurely declares the MVP complete
findings.verification: Confirm README status agrees with CURRENT.md, ISSUE-0006 state, and the M1 definition of done without implying human or milestone acceptance.

limitations: The read-only, socket-restricted review environment prevented successful execution of all required checks; these failures do not independently demonstrate a product defect.
Live Microsoft authentication and Graph fetching were not attempted because they are protected actions requiring separate tenant-specific human approval.
The supplied base and target are not in an ancestor relationship, so review identity is based on the exact explicit base-to-target tree diff.
No browser-based interactive walkthrough was possible because the sandbox prohibits binding the local HTTP server.
review.summary: BLOCKED. The alternate-port and persistence-wording repairs are correct, and the diff contains no product-code changes, but required checks cannot be independently verified in this sandbox. Two substantive documentation/governance inconsistencies remain: CURRENT.md still directs a fresh task to redo the completed repair, and README declares the MVP complete before ISSUE-0006 and the M1 gates are complete.
